title: Urgent probe into cyberattacks vs gov’t agencies needed, says ex-solon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former lawmaker Robert Ace Barbers on Wednesday called on the government to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the reported cyberattacks targeting government agencies and private institutions, warning that it has become a national security concern. Barbers made the pronouncement amid reports that 20 Philippine institutions have been allegedly compromised recently by hackers. According to Barbers, this should serve as a “wake-up call” for authorities to strengthen cybersecurity defenses, especially before it escalates into widespread financial losses, identity theft, and disruption of essential public services.
